_comment: All dimensions in mm. Shared by all scripts in this project.
_cavity_taper: Per-side inward offset at cavity floor. Top=70, bottom=60 means taper=5.
_magnet_height: Thickness of disc magnet — goes through the wall thickness direction.
_magnet_pocket_height: Vertical extent of the pocket. Starts at floor level, open at top for drop-in.
_magnet_outer_offset: Distance from outer box surface to nearest face of magnet pocket.
_key_comment: Ridge/groove keying. Ridge on ±X walls (male/north), groove on ±Y walls (female/south).
_key_height: Height from box bottom. Feature stops here; tiny overhang at transition.
